feature.title: Explain selection
feature.problem: Reading something unfamiliar in any app (a term, a snippet, a sentence) means leaving it, opening a browser or chat, pasting, and reading the answer somewhere else. Parley already sits over every app, so a third gesture can explain the current selection in a markdown popover right beside it.
nonGoals: Follow-up questions or chat. One selection, one explanation, then dismiss.
Voice: the gesture is a trigger only, nothing is recorded.
Windows and Linux. Anchoring and selection reading use the macOS Accessibility API.
Long essays. The prompt asks for a short answer; the card is built to fit it without scrolling.

surfaces.name: Explanation popover
surfaces.purpose: Show the explanation next to the selection without stealing focus from the app.

states.loading: Card appears at once at the selection with three shimmer lines; text streams in as it arrives.
states.empty: No selection found: card says 'Select some text first' and dismisses itself after 2 s.
states.error: One line in the card: 'No MiniMax key', 'No connection', 'Rate limited' — same wording as voice edit.
states.success: Markdown rendered (headings, lists, code, bold). Card sizes to its content, up to 60% of the display height, then and only then scrolls. Esc, click outside, or a new selection dismisses.

surfaces.name: Settings, Gesture tab
surfaces.purpose: Choose which key triggers Explain, next to the dictate and edit keys.

states.loading: Settings load synchronously with the tab; no separate loading state.
states.empty: Explain key equal to another gesture key means Explain is off, with the same hint edit uses.
states.error: No MiniMax key: row shows a hint pointing to the Setup tab.
states.success: Selecting a key saves immediately, as the other rows do.

overlays.title: Explain
overlays.body: Markdown answer, anchored to the selection rectangle; falls back to the cursor when the app hides its selection bounds.

components.why: must float over other apps and never take focus from the selection; Mantine Popover only lives inside our own windows
answer is markdown; renders to React elements with no innerHTML, so model output cannot inject markup
answer shape is known: a few text lines
the card grows to fit its content and only scrolls past 60% of display height; short answers make that rare
components.rejected: fixed-height card that scrolls by default

components.why: eight fixed modifier keys, same as the existing rows
main resizes the window to the rendered content height (renderer reports it over IPC), so there is no inner scrollbar until the cap; the window is transparent so extra size is invisible
system prompt asks for at most ~80 words: one-line meaning, then at most 3 bullets or one short example; no headings, no preamble. Fewer lines is the main way to avoid scrolling

entities.name: Settings.explainGestureKey

fields.name: explainGestureKey
fields.note: default CtrlRight; equal to another key = off

relations: reuses tapCount, so all three gestures share one tap count

fields.name: anchor
fields.note: AX bounds of selected range, screen coordinates

fields.name: maxHeight
fields.note: 0.6 x work-area height of the anchor display; card is 420 px wide so lines wrap less

endpoints.purpose: Rewriter.explain(), same key, endpoint and error kinds as voice edit; streaming optional in a later step

integration.note: tap-tap-hold on the explain key fires onStart; hold release is ignored, it is a trigger only
read selection text and bounds for any focused element that is not a password field; multi-line selections anchor to the whole selection rectangle
Chrome and Electron often hide AX text: copy, read, restore the clipboard, anchor at the cursor
main pushes state (loading, text, error, rect) to the explain window; only that window may send dismiss
window is unfocusable, so dismissal comes from the global hook

verification: Manual: select text in Safari, Notes and VS Code; tap-tap-hold the explain key; card appears at the selection with markdown
Manual: password field selection yields nothing; no MiniMax key shows the error line
